summary: The registrant, John Hancock Comvest Private Income Fund, filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to report a routine monthly dividend declaration for its Class I common shares ($0.1989 per share, payable June 24, 2026) and disclose its April 30, 2026 NAV ($25.12 per share for Class I, aggregate NAV $468M) and ongoing continuous offering status. No special situation—acquisition, divestiture, tender, restructuring, or similar—is present. This is a standard periodic update for a BDC. Category: None.
